title: 半导体设备承压，能源与社交媒体占优；三份业绩预告等待开盘验证
summary: 10月13日A股宽度接近平衡而港股偏弱；隔夜美股炼化、勘探和社交媒体居前，半导体设备与材料跌3.12%。恩捷股份、星宸科技和中钨高新披露显著业绩改善，但公告后价格反应尚未知，均列条件关注。

关键词云图

芯片设备承压业绩预增港股宽度弱能源强势平台反弹健康中国西部建设等待价格确认
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
地缘与能源
伊朗加大航运扰动，油价风险溢价未消
Reuters称伊朗调整策略并扩大对海湾航运的干扰范围；Brent 10月13日结算跌0.9%至105.69美元，但供应与保险风险仍高。A/H上游能源有相对支撑，航空、化工下游和物流继续承受成本压力。 source
国内政策
全国卫生与健康大会强化健康优先与医药创新
工信部转载的新华社原文显示，会议要求推进医疗、医保、医药协同改革，健全药品供应保障并推动科技赋能医药卫生；这为医疗服务、创新药和医疗信息化提供中长期政策线索，但不等于短线业绩兑现。 source
国内政策
发改委协调推进西部大开发重点事项
国家发改委10月13日披露专题会议，要求强化政策协同并推进重点事项落实，贵州、广西、云南、内蒙古等地参与；西部基建、区域国企与能源项目获得观察线索，仍需后续项目清单和资金落地验证。 source
隔夜科技
半导体设备链下跌，AMAT领跌强化负面映射
Moomoo行业快照显示半导体设备与材料跌3.12%、23跌7涨；最新延迟报价中AMAT跌6.70%、MU跌3.68%、ASML ADR跌1.90%，而AXTI涨4.32%。A/H设备、存储与材料链应先看开盘承接，不能只用国产替代叙事对冲全球估值压力。 source
平台与广告
社交媒体行业走强但港股平台仍需本地确认
社交媒体概念涨2.62%，PINS涨4.44%、META最新延迟报价涨2.61%；对腾讯、快手及广告科技只构成情绪映射。10月13日恒生科技盘中跌1.23%，若平台股不能跑赢恒科，隔夜强势即视为未传导。 source
电子分销
电子与计算机分销上涨但由微盘股集中驱动
行业涨2.16%，8涨0跌，代表股IZM涨44.40%；极端涨幅集中于小市值个股，不能外推为A/H全产业链订单改善。国内分销、PCB与连接器需以量价和公司公告独立确认。 source
恩捷股份
前三季度预计扭亏，隔膜景气修复待开盘验证
公司预计前三季度归母净利润15.4亿至20.5亿元，上年同期亏损8632.3万元，称隔膜需求、利用率与价格改善。10月13日收44.42元、跌5.17%并创60日低点，且该价格早于晚间预告；业绩利好尚未获得价格确认。 source
星宸科技
前三季度净利润预计增长663%至698%
公司预计前三季度归母净利润15.43亿至16.13亿元、营收45.38亿至46.08亿元，端边侧AI SoC量价齐升；10月13日收109.98元、跌3.97%，同样是公告前价格。强业绩与隔夜芯片压力并存，开盘相对强度是关键。 source
中钨高新
前三季度净利润预计增长219%至241%
公司预计前三季度归母净利润29亿至31亿元（重述后同比增长219%至241%），钨价与PCB微钻量价齐升；10月13日收48.17元、跌0.35%，此前一日跌5.46%。预告未经审计且钨价冲高回落，下游需求分化仍是反证。 source
新能源映射
太阳能与固态电池同步居前，A/H只做条件映射
美股太阳能行业涨3.48%，固态电池概念涨1.96%；SMXT与TM分别上涨7.44%和2.16%。恩捷业绩预告提供本地隔膜线索，但其昨收弱势且公告后尚未交易，新能源链不能直接按美股涨幅追价。 source

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
截至10月14日07:54—07:59 CST，延迟ETF代理SPY -0.03%、QQQ -0.35%、DIA -0.36%；这些是最新可得延迟/延长时段代理，不是同一时点指数期货。成长代理弱于大盘，未给出全面风险偏好修复。
板块对照
15只代表股已批量复核：PARR +8.14%、SMXT +5.99%、XRX +4.61%、SJT +12.25%、IZM +38.67%；HSLV +0.60%、SAIQ +12.67%、TCRT +188.57%、AXTI +4.32%、BEEP -3.65%；PINS +4.37%、TM +2.12%、PSX +3.98%、CNX +2.64%、ICG +7.82%。报价与榜单方向大体一致，能源、社交媒体为确认，半导体设备仍弱；但数据源只返回相对前收的总涨跌，不能当作纯盘后增量。
A/H 映射
隔夜能源与社交媒体强、半导体设备弱；A/H开盘增量上，油气与平台股可观察相对强度，芯片设备与高估值成长先看承接。若恒科跑赢恒指且半导体设备止跌，可下调科技风险；若油价反弹并伴随科技继续弱于大盘，则防御优先。

盘前结论

10月13日AKShare盘中快照显示A股2697涨、2679跌、中位数0%，上证仅跌0.06%，总量并非单边弱势；但港股753涨、1566跌，恒生科技跌1.23%，港股成长基线更脆弱。隔夜半导体设备与材料跌3.12%、QQQ延迟代理跌0.35%，科技开盘需先验证而非追价。

恩捷、星宸和中钨高新的业绩预告均提供真实公司级催化。三者10月13日价格都早于晚间公告，且恩捷、星宸当日分别跌5.17%和3.97%，所以只列条件关注；开盘后的成交、相对行业强度与公告后价格反应决定是否升级。

重点个股关注

恩捷股份
A.002812
条件关注
事实与状态：预计前三季度归母净利润15.4亿至20.5亿元，同比扭亏；10月13日收44.42元、跌5.17%，该价格早于晚间预告，尚无公告后确认。 source
确认条件：开盘后先收复44.42元并转为强于电池/固态电池板块，进一步突破10月13日高点45.87元且量能健康。
风险与失效：若高开低走、继续创低，或隔膜价格/需求改善未在三季报兑现，则维持观望；对外担保、质押与行业产能仍需跟踪。
星宸科技
A.301536
条件关注
事实与状态：预计前三季度净利润15.43亿至16.13亿元、同比增663.13%至697.75%，端边侧AI SoC量价齐升；10月13日收109.98元、跌3.97%，是公告前价格。 source
确认条件：开盘后跑赢半导体指数并站回111.82元上方，同时成交承接而非短促脉冲，方可把业绩催化视为价格确认。
风险与失效：隔夜芯片设备链明显走弱；预告未经审计，且1亿元产业基金投资周期长、流动性低。若跌破104.72元附近并放量，条件关注失效。
中钨高新
A.000657
条件关注
事实与状态：预计前三季度归母净利润29亿至31亿元，重述后同比增219%至241%，钨精矿与PCB微钻量价改善；10月13日收48.17元、跌0.35%，前一日跌5.46%。 source
确认条件：开盘后守住48.17元并放量突破10月13日高点49.06元，同时钨/小金属板块不转弱，才视为公告获得正反馈。
风险与失效：预告未经审计，钨价冲高回落及下游需求分化是公司已披露反证；若继续弱于小金属板块或跌破45.75元，取消关注。

板块轮动看板

油气与炼化美股炼化+4.11%、勘探开发+2.22%，Brent仍在105美元上方；A/H只关注有产量、炼化价差或现金流支撑者。
半导体设备与存储行业-3.12%，AMAT -6.70%、MU -3.68%；A/H国产替代逻辑需用开盘承接和订单公告验证。
业绩预增与端侧AI星宸、中钨与恩捷披露高增长或扭亏；公告后价格尚未知，先看量价再决定是否升级。
医疗与西部建设健康中国和西部大开发提供中长期政策线索；短线需后续文件、项目清单和资金落地。

逻辑链

伊朗加大航运扰动 → Brent仍在105美元上方 → 油气相对占优、航空与化工下游成本压力延续。
美股半导体设备-3.12%且AMAT -6.70% → 全球芯片估值与竞争担忧升温 → A/H设备、存储先验证承接。
A股宽度接近平衡但港股跌多涨少 → 总量震荡、港股成长更脆弱 → 平台与恒科需以相对强度确认。
三份A股业绩预告在昨收后披露 → 旧价格不能代表公告反应 → 只列条件关注并设置开盘确认/失效线。

风险雷达

地缘与油价航运袭扰或供应扰动升级会推高通胀与运费，压制成长估值和下游利润。
科技负反馈半导体设备行业和AMAT、MU走弱；若A/H芯片开盘继续放量下跌，不以国产替代叙事逆势追价。
公告后价格未知三只条件关注股的昨收均早于业绩预告，任何实时买点都待10月14日开盘确认。
数据时效AKShare为10月13日14:47盘中快照；美股代理为07:54—07:59 CST延迟报价，均已明确时点而非实时无延迟行情。

数据来源与时间点

Keyword Cloud

Chip equipment pressureEarnings upsideWeak HK breadthEnergy strengthPlatform reboundHealth ChinaWestern projectsAwait price confirmation
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Geopolitics & Energy
Iran steps up shipping disruption; oil risk premium persists
Reuters reported that Iran changed tactics and broadened interference with Gulf shipping. Brent settled 0.9% lower at US$105.69 on Oct 13, but supply and insurance risks remain high. A/H upstream energy retains relative support while airlines, chemical downstream users and logistics face cost pressure. source
Domestic Policy
National health conference reinforces health priority and medical innovation
The official Xinhua text republished by MIIT calls for coordinated medical-service, insurance and pharmaceutical reform, better drug supply and more technology in healthcare. This supports longer-term medical services, innovative drugs and health IT, but does not guarantee near-term earnings. source
Domestic Policy
NDRC coordinates priority items for western development
NDRC said on Oct 13 that ministries and Guizhou, Guangxi, Yunnan and Inner Mongolia discussed priority implementation and stronger policy coordination. Western infrastructure, regional SOEs and energy projects gain a watch signal, subject to project lists and funding. source
Overnight Tech
Semiconductor equipment falls; AMAT leads the negative mapping
Moomoo's industry snapshot showed semiconductor equipment and materials down 3.12%, with 23 decliners and seven advancers. Latest delayed quotes showed AMAT -6.70%, MU -3.68%, ASML ADR -1.90% and AXTI +4.32%. A/H equipment, memory and materials need opening support rather than a blanket localization narrative. source
Platforms & Ads
Social media rises, but Hong Kong platforms still need local confirmation
Social Media rose 2.62%; PINS gained 4.44% and META's latest delayed quote was +2.61%. That is only a sentiment read-through for Tencent, Kuaishou and ad-tech. Hang Seng Tech fell 1.23% intraday on Oct 13; failure to outperform HSTECH would mean no local transmission. source
Electronics Distribution
Electronics distribution gains, but a micro-cap drives concentration
The industry rose 2.16%, with eight advancers and no decliners, while representative IZM jumped 44.40%. The extreme move is concentrated in a micro-cap and cannot establish broad A/H order improvement. Domestic distributors, PCB and connector names need their own volume and disclosure confirmation. source
Yunnan Energy New Material
Nine-month profit expected to turn positive; separator recovery awaits the open
The company expects nine-month attributable profit of RMB1.54-2.05bn versus a RMB86.3m loss a year earlier, citing demand, utilization and price recovery. The stock closed Oct 13 at RMB44.42, down 5.17% and at a 60-day low; that price preceded the evening forecast, so the catalyst is unconfirmed. source
SigmaStar Technology
Nine-month profit expected to rise 663%-698%
SigmaStar expects nine-month attributable profit of RMB1.543-1.613bn and revenue of RMB4.538-4.608bn, supported by volume and pricing in edge AI SoCs. It closed Oct 13 at RMB109.98, down 3.97%, also before the announcement. Strong earnings and overnight chip pressure coexist; relative strength at the open is decisive. source
China Tungsten High-tech
Nine-month profit expected to rise 219%-241%
The company expects nine-month attributable profit of RMB2.9-3.1bn, up 219%-241% on a restated basis, citing tungsten pricing and PCB micro-drill volume and pricing. It closed Oct 13 at RMB48.17, down 0.35%, after a 5.46% decline the prior day. The unaudited forecast, tungsten pullback and uneven downstream demand are counter-evidence. source
New-energy Mapping
Solar and solid-state batteries lead together; A/H mapping stays conditional
US Solar rose 3.48% and Solid State Battery gained 1.96%; SMXT and TM rose 7.44% and 2.16%. Yunnan Energy New Material's forecast supplies a local separator catalyst, but its prior close was weak and post-announcement trading has not occurred, so the A/H chain is not a chase. source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index proxies
As of 07:54-07:59 CST on Oct 14, delayed ETF proxies showed SPY -0.03%, QQQ -0.35% and DIA -0.36%. These are the latest available delayed/extended-hours proxies, not same-time index futures. Growth lagged the broad market and did not signal a full risk-on repair.
Sector cross-check
All 15 representative stocks were batch-checked: PARR +8.14%, SMXT +5.99%, XRX +4.61%, SJT +12.25%, IZM +38.67%; HSLV +0.60%, SAIQ +12.67%, TCRT +188.57%, AXTI +4.32%, BEEP -3.65%; PINS +4.37%, TM +2.12%, PSX +3.98%, CNX +2.64%, ICG +7.82%. Direction broadly confirms the ranking: energy and social media are confirmed, semiconductor equipment stays weak. The feed reports total change from the prior close, not clean post-close incremental moves.
A/H mapping
Overnight energy and social media were strong while semiconductor equipment was weak. At the A/H open, watch oil and platform relative strength; chip equipment and expensive growth need support first. HSTECH outperforming HSI with chip equipment stabilizing would reduce the tech-risk discount; a renewed oil rise with tech lagging would favor defense.

Pre-open View

The Oct 13 AKShare intraday snapshot showed 2,697 A-share advancers, 2,679 decliners and a 0% median, with Shanghai down only 0.06%; the broad market was not one-way weak. Hong Kong was more fragile with 753 advancers, 1,566 decliners and HSTECH down 1.23%.US semiconductor equipment fell 3.12% and the delayed QQQ proxy lost 0.35%, so technology needs opening confirmation rather than chasing.

Yunnan Energy New Material, SigmaStar and China Tungsten each disclosed a verifiable company-level earnings catalyst.All Oct 13 prices preceded the evening forecasts, while Yunnan Energy New Material and SigmaStar fell 5.17% and 3.97%. They remain Conditional Watches until opening volume, industry-relative strength and the actual post-announcement reaction confirm them.

Stocks to Watch

Yunnan Energy New Material
A.002812
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: nine-month attributable profit is expected at RMB1.54-2.05bn, turning positive year on year. The stock closed Oct 13 at RMB44.42, down 5.17%; that price preceded the evening forecast, so there is no post-announcement confirmation. source
Confirmation: first reclaim RMB44.42 and outperform the battery/solid-state group, then clear the Oct 13 high of RMB45.87 on healthy volume.
Risk & invalidation: a gap-and-fade, new low, or failure of separator pricing and demand to appear in the third-quarter report keeps the stance neutral. Guarantees, pledges and industry capacity remain watch items.
SigmaStar Technology
A.301536
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: nine-month profit is expected at RMB1.543-1.613bn, up 663.13%-697.75%, with edge AI SoC volume and pricing improving. It closed Oct 13 at RMB109.98, down 3.97%, before the forecast. source
Confirmation: outperform the semiconductor index and reclaim RMB111.82 with durable turnover, not a brief spike, before treating earnings as price-confirmed.
Risk & invalidation: overnight chip equipment was clearly weak; the forecast is unaudited, and the RMB100m industry fund is long-duration and illiquid. A high-volume break below RMB104.72 invalidates the watch.
China Tungsten High-tech
A.000657
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: nine-month attributable profit is expected at RMB2.9-3.1bn, up 219%-241% restated, on tungsten and PCB micro-drill improvement. It closed Oct 13 at RMB48.17, down 0.35%, after losing 5.46% the prior day. source
Confirmation: hold RMB48.17, clear the Oct 13 high of RMB49.06 on volume, and avoid renewed weakness in tungsten/small metals before the catalyst is price-confirmed.
Risk & invalidation: the forecast is unaudited; tungsten prices have pulled back and downstream demand is uneven. Continued underperformance or a break below RMB45.75 cancels the watch.

Sector Rotation

Oil & RefiningUS refining +4.11% and E&P +2.22% with Brent above US$105; focus only on A/H names with real production, margins or cash flow.
Chip Equipment & MemoryThe industry fell 3.12%, AMAT -6.70% and MU -3.68%; A/H localization needs opening support and order disclosures.
Earnings Upside & Edge AISigmaStar, China Tungsten and Yunnan Energy New Material guided to high growth or a turnaround; wait for post-announcement price action.
Healthcare & Western ProjectsHealth China and western development offer longer-term policy signals; near-term trading needs follow-up documents, project lists and funding.

Logic Chain

More Iranian shipping disruption → Brent stays above US$105 → upstream energy gains relative support while airlines and chemical users face costs.
US semiconductor equipment -3.12% and AMAT -6.70% → global valuation and competition concerns rise → A/H equipment and memory must prove support.
Near-balanced A-share breadth but weak Hong Kong breadth → range-bound aggregate tape with fragile HK growth → platforms and HSTECH need relative-strength confirmation.
Three A-share earnings forecasts arrived after the prior close → old prices cannot represent the announcement reaction → use Conditional Watch cards with opening confirmation and invalidation levels.

Risk Radar

Geopolitics & OilMore shipping attacks or supply disruption could lift inflation and freight costs, weighing on growth valuations and downstream margins.
Technology FeedbackSemiconductor equipment, AMAT and MU were weak. Do not chase A/H chips against a high-volume selloff using localization alone.
Unknown Post-announcement PricesAll three watch-list prices predate the earnings forecasts; any real-time entry remains contingent on the Oct 14 open.
